manifest.name: duplicate-candidate
manifest.description: Two records a deterministic rule says may be the same customer, with the rule and its evidence recorded. Nothing here is ever resolved automatically: an ambiguous match stays unresolved until a human decides, and no rule breaks a tie by picking one.

migrations.name: create_duplicate_candidates
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS duplicate_candidates (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  left_resource TEXT,
  left_id TEXT,
  left_owner TEXT CHECK(left_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  left_owner_package TEXT,
  left_label TEXT,
  right_resource TEXT,
  right_id TEXT,
  right_owner TEXT CHECK(right_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  right_owner_package TEXT,
  right_label TEXT,
  policy TEXT,
  policy_version INTEGER,
  policy_fingerprint TEXT,
  rule TEXT,
  evidence TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('unresolved', 'linked', 'dismissed')),
  detected_by_run_id TEXT,
  detected_at TEXT,
  decision_id TEXT,
  decided_reason TEXT,
  decided_by_type TEXT CHECK(decided_by_type IN ('user')),
  decided_by_id TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS duplicate_candidates_left_resource ON duplicate_candidates(left_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS duplicate_candidates_left_id ON duplicate_candidates(left_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS duplicate_candidates_right_resource ON duplicate_candidates(right_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS duplicate_candidates_right_id ON duplicate_candidates(right_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS duplicate_candidates_status ON duplicate_candidates(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_duplicate_candidates
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."duplicate_candidates" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "left_resource" TEXT,
  "left_id" TEXT,
  "left_owner" TEXT CHECK("left_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "left_owner_package" TEXT,
  "left_label" TEXT,
  "right_resource" TEXT,
  "right_id" TEXT,
  "right_owner" TEXT CHECK("right_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "right_owner_package" TEXT,
  "right_label" TEXT,
  "policy" TEXT,
  "policy_version" BIGINT,
  "policy_fingerprint" TEXT,
  "rule" TEXT,
  "evidence" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('unresolved', 'linked', 'dismissed')),
  "detected_by_run_id" TEXT,
  "detected_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "decision_id" TEXT,
  "decided_reason" TEXT,
  "decided_by_type" TEXT CHECK("decided_by_type" IN ('user')),
  "decided_by_id" TEXT,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "duplicate_candidates_left_resource"
  ON "accordo"."duplicate_candidates"("left_resource");

CREATE INDEX "duplicate_candidates_left_id"
  ON "accordo"."duplicate_candidates"("left_id");

CREATE INDEX "duplicate_candidates_right_resource"
  ON "accordo"."duplicate_candidates"("right_resource");

CREATE INDEX "duplicate_candidates_right_id"
  ON "accordo"."duplicate_candidates"("right_id");

CREATE INDEX "duplicate_candidates_status"
  ON "accordo"."duplicate_candidates"("status");
